evidence.label: SCRIPTED-AGENT PIPELINE VALIDATION — deterministic demo_provider policies with ground-truth labels by construction; not evidence about any learned model.

known_attack_coverage.note: every attack in this experiment was known when verifier 1.0.0 / verified-v1 were designed (development set); FP rates here do not measure robustness to unseen attacks — see Experiment H.

notes: R1/R2 are research-only baselines and are never used as production reward.
ground truth = scripted policy label (deserves_reward), independent of all three verifiers
'permissive harness' disables visible-test write protection to show what R2 rewards when an environment fails to protect its tests.
